selection.source: MP-DocVQA official train for memory and validation for locally scoreable held-out tasks
selection.stratification: one question per document; same page-count-bin quotas in both sets
selection.isolation: 100 unique doc_ids per set; no doc_id overlap across sets; exclude every doc_id used in the 10/5 pilot
selection.note: The official test split has no local reference answers. This initial locally-scored test uses validation tasks; treat it as a pilot held-out set, not a sealed official test set.

near_duplicate_policy: Exclude prior pilot IDs and exact image hashes; MP-DocVQA also excludes document IDs across and within sets. Semantic/template near duplicates are not certified.
test_policy: Static evaluation: bank is frozen; no test feedback or answer is written to memory.
